alt_text: The paper, Attention Is All You Need, introduces a novel architecture that eliminates the need for recurrence in sequence modeling.
The Transformer model architecture illustrates how attention mechanisms model dependencies without recurrence, allowing for global context understanding.
Sequential bottlenecks in previous models. Convolutional models require O(n/k) layers to connect distant positions, creating sequential bottlenecks.
The page explains the Pure Self-Attention Architecture Design. It shows diagrams for Scaled Dot-Product Attention and Multi-Head Attention, illustrating parallel processing.
The Transformer model achieved a BLEU score of 28.4 on English-to-German and 41.0 on English-to-French for WMT 2014 tasks.
